name: Flexible
description: Full refund up to 48 hours before the activity starts. No refund thereafter.

name: Moderate
description: Full refund up to 7 days before. Half refund between 7 days and 48 hours. No refund thereafter.

name: Strict
description: Full refund up to 14 days before. Half refund between 14 and 7 days. No refund thereafter.
